title: Main output level light
author: MrScruff (rytm-mods); elemod port: Iced-Cream
description: On both compressor pages - stock's and 0006's preview - the VOL knob's label draws inverted while the main output's RMS level is over rms_db, for gain staging. The level is the louder of MAIN L and R, each a mean square averaged with a 300 ms time constant; a full-scale square wave reads 0 dBFS and a full-scale sine -3.01. The label turns on above the threshold and off 1 dB below it. MAIN is read each audio interrupt from the receive buffer - the pair USB and the sampler record, after the compressor. The master volume knob does not set that pair, though an interaction in the circuit moves it by up to a few dB over the knob's travel. The label is inverted by XOR in the box stock highlights labels with, so a label stock has already highlighted reads normal while over. The drawing reaches the compressor view only: its vtable's two knob draw slots point at wrappers, which run stock's draw and then the inversion. Began as a clip indicator (any MAIN sample at -0.07 dBFS). Measured 2026-09-26, the Rytm's USB MAIN showed no saturation at any compressor VOL - no pile-up at the ceiling, no flattened peaks, no added harmonics - and the audible distortion was the monitoring interface's input, so a level reference for gain staging replaced it. Hardware, 2026-09-26: the drawing path inverts the label on both pages. Port of rytm-mods 0009-main-rms.
